body:
🎵 TomLWSM Music Discs
Bring a new sound experience to Minecraft
✨ Overview

TomLWSM Music Discs is a Minecraft resource pack that integrates music from TomLWSM directly into the game using vanilla music discs.

Instead of replacing the Minecraft atmosphere, this pack enhances it by turning music discs into a fully playable collection of tracks—just drop them into a jukebox and enjoy.

Perfect for survival worlds, servers, or chill sessions, this pack adds a fresh musical identity while staying true to Minecraft’s core experience.

🎧 Features
💿 Replaces multiple Minecraft music discs
🎵 Includes original tracks by TomLWSM
🎮 Fully compatible with vanilla gameplay
🔊 Seamless integration with jukebox mechanics
🌍 Enhances immersion without changing core visuals
💿 Disc Tracklist

⚠️ Disc names are not yet customizable in this version.

Cat	Pas ma place — TomLWSM

📦 Information
🎤 Artist: TomLWSM
📁 Type: Resource Pack
💿 Modified Discs: 8
🎵 Total Tracks: 8
⚙️ Installation
Download the resource pack
Place it in your .minecraft/resourcepacks folder
Enable it in-game
Insert a disc into a jukebox and enjoy 🎶

❤️ Credits
All music by TomLWSM
Pack integration and setup by the creator

🚧 Notes
Disc names will be customizable in a future update
Works best with the latest Minecraft versions
No gameplay changes—audio only
